title: Heavyweight champion on CIA operations in Lebanon
place_text: Brotherhood Synagogue, Greenwich Village, New York

tellings.quote: He's talking to us about running operations for the CIA in Lebanon.

plain: In the late 1960s, a heavyweight champion named Andre Pinacio spoke at the Brotherhood Synagogue in Greenwich Village, New York, about running operations for the CIA in Lebanon. The author Peter Levenda tells Michels this as something he heard in person, sitting in the audience: 'He's talking to us about running operations for the CIA in Lebanon.'
